name: Walmart
outlook:
What Walmart says to expect

  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: sales and incomeFor Q3, net sales are expected to grow 3.0% to 3.75% and adjusted operating income to grow 2.0% to 4.0%.
  • Fiscal year 2027: sales and incomeNet sales for FY27 are expected to grow 4.0% to 5.0% and adjusted operating income to grow 7.0% to 8.5%, all in constant currency (“cc”) 1 .
  • Quarter and fiscal year 2027: adjusted EPSAdjusted EPS 1 is expected to be $0.62 to $0.64 for Q3 and $2.80 to $2.87 for FY27.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed August 20, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
